notes: This portable slice composes adapter-supplied application and update-rate FOM modules. The queried subject has one active object-attribute subscription and one passive application interaction subscription. A separate requester identifies that subject in HLArequestSubscriptions and validates the standard object, interaction, and directed-interaction reports. The interaction report contains exactly the selected class with its passive HLAactive indicator false; the object report retains the selected active state, update-rate name, and attribute list; the directed-interaction response uses the standard empty NULL shape. It does not cover multiple classes, multiple rates, DDM regions, populated directed subscriptions, or overall MOM conformance.

requirements.statement: The subject actively subscribes to the adapter-selected object-class attribute with the adapter-selected update-rate designator; the standard MIM report identifies that class, active state, update-rate name, and exact attribute handle.

The subject passively subscribes to the adapter-selected interaction class with the standard active argument set to false; the report's interaction-subscription pair must retain that class handle and report HLAactive=false.
The requester sends HLArequestSubscriptions through the standard sendInteraction service and uses its inherited HLAfederate parameter to identify the joined subject whose declarations are queried.

The standard reports identify the subject's active object subscription and passive interaction subscription. The interaction-class list contains the selected interaction handle paired with HLAactive=false as defined by the MIM's HLAinteractionSubscription record. With no directed interactions, the directed report is a NULL response with zero classes, omitted object-class parameter, and an empty interaction-class list.
